rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Production-oriented MCP server wrapper around LLAMATOR for automated LLM red teaming and security testing. Provides both HTTP API and MCP tool interfaces for submitting asynchronous test runs against OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with execution orchestrated via ARQ/Redis and artifacts stored in MinIO with presigned download URLs. Features API key protection, request persistence with secret redaction, Prometheus metrics, and comprehensive job lifecycle management including status tracking and error handling.
